h0.story: Hub construct: appears in every subsystem.

h1.name: Burden of general cardiovascular disease
h1.story: Hub construct: appears in every subsystem.

n0.name: Metabolic Control and Cardiovascular Risk
n0.story: GLP-1 receptor agonists reduce cardiovascular burden by improving glycemic control, reducing body weight, and optimizing lipid profiles, which in turn informs clinical prescribing guidelines.

n1.name: Organ Aging and Systemic Inflammation
n1.story: GLP-1 receptor agonists mitigate organ aging and cardiovascular disease by suppressing systemic inflammation, oxidative stress, and fibrosis while supporting kidney function.

n2.name: Healthcare Economics and Access
variables: Extent of general insurance coverage for medications
Availability of GLP-1RA and anti-obesity medications
n2.story: The utilization of GLP-1 receptor agonists is driven by insurance coverage and availability, which is reinforced by the drug's ability to improve QALYs and cost-effectiveness despite high initial costs.

n3.name: Tolerability and Treatment Adherence
variables: Incidence and severity of general adverse events
Level of patient treatment adherence and engagement
Treatment discontinuation rate due to adverse events
Level of provider support and guidance
n3.story: The effectiveness of GLP-1 receptor agonists is moderated by a feedback loop where dose-dependent adverse events reduce adherence, while patient support and the severity of cardiovascular disease motivate persistence.
